snippet.title: The Knightling - Galaxies Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Showcase 2025
snippet.description: The Knightling is an open-world action-adventure where you step into the boots of a young squire on a quest to find their missing mentor, the legendary Sir Lionstone. Armed with nothing but a mythical shield, you’ll journey across the vast lands of Clesseia, uncovering secrets, battling foes, and rising to become a hero no one saw coming.
